title: Positivity of the optimality parameter
statement: For each natural number $q$, choose a dimension $N=r+1$ such that the upper-tail indicator of the normalized sum of $N$ uniform signs has mass within half of $1/(q+2)$ of that value, and level-one Fourier weight within half the square of the corresponding standard Gaussian density of that square. The parameter equal to twice the mass of this upper-tail indicator is strictly positive.
